title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1414 lines)
detail: File is 1414 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 3 sites (L854,L884,L1193)
detail: `except Exception` catches all exceptions without re-raising, swallowing unexpected errors silently. This hides failures and makes the caller unable to distinguish success from silent failure. Suggested fix: catch only the exception types the callee can raise, or use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()` for cleanup handlers.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 1 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L992)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Exception context suppressed: 2 `raise` statements without `from` (L916,L1089)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.

title: Star-arg unpacking after keyword argument (B026) at L301,305,614
detail: Positional star-arg unpacking placed after a keyword argument is a Python SyntaxError in Python 3 when used in a function call. Ruff B026 flags calls that will raise `SyntaxError` at runtime. Suggested fix: move all positional arguments before keyword arguments.

title: Unnecessary `pass` in abstract/stub methods (7 instances)
detail: Abstract method stubs or pure interface declarations contain a bare `pass` statement alongside a docstring or `raise NotImplementedError`. The `pass` is redundant when a docstring or `raise` already makes the function body non-empty. Suggested fix: remove the redundant `pass` statements.
